profile.headline: Software Engineer at Roku Inc.
profile.summary: Experienced Senior Embedded Software Engineer with a demonstrated history of working in the networking, medical device, and consumer electronics industries. Skilled in application and BSP development. Strong engineering professional with a Bachelor of Science focused in Electrical Engineering from Sonoma State University.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- All things SW for an embedded medical eye imaging system.
- Design and development of a multichannel camera streaming and still capture multithreaded C++ application using Qt, STL, OpenCV, and Boost.
- BSP work for Nvidia Jetson. Rootfs and kernel development.
- Device drivers: I2C devices (battery chargers, human interface devices [force sensitive button, touch screen controller], custom microcontrollers, temperature sensors, camera sensors, focused devices,  power controllers), USB ethernet adapter back porting.
- Designed and implemented contrast autofocus functionality for the platform.
- Kernel patching for video input devices, camera sensors, and misc. other devices.
- Application integration with CUDA and image processing modules.
- Ground up Yocto based custom distro development and developer environment.
- Performance testing and tuning. Device endurance testing and life projection given real and simulated product workloads.
- Drove quality and release schedule.
- Engineering documentation and technical requirements gathering.
- Project schedule planning.
- Remote contractor management.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Focused on set top box hardware running a Linux based OS.
- Bug fixes, stability improvements, and metrics hooks in a large multithreaded C++ application.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Embedded linux development - BSP - device drivers, boot, file systems, kernel hacking, and target board upgrades.
- Board bringup and HW verification.
- FPGA loaders and bit stream management focused on Xilinx devices. Implemented a PCIe based bit stream loader.
- In depth knowledge of NXP T-series PowerPC and Intel Broadwell-D x86 SoCs.
- I2C, SPI, Ethernet, PHY integration, PCIe, SDHC/MMC, optical module integration, and fan control.
- C++/C/Bash/Python development.
- Yocto recipes - from scratch, appends, and patch creation.
- Broadcom DNX and XGS SDK shell knowledge for board verification. Spirent network generator operator. Broadcom Pioneer EPON MAC bringup.
- Schematic review and feed back to HW team for new products.
- Manufacturing operations support.

positions.title: Applications Engineer
positions.description:
-	Diagnosed and repaired issues on various CNC milling and turning machines.
-	Oversaw day to day machine maintenance.
-	Upgraded technology (computers, networks, software, and machines) throughout the company.
-	Implemented an automated polishing solution for intricate and odd shaped precision bicycle components, using the Motoman SK-45X handling robot. 
-	Designed and assisted machining parts for projects.
-	Created an automated solution for buffer wheel wear. 
-	Integrated peripheral I/O into the robot controller – pneumatic actuators, high-power motor systems and safety devices. Programmed all robot operations.

positions.title: Undergraduate Research Assistant
positions.description:
- Implemented multiple fused filament fabrication rapid prototyping machines (3D printers) based upon the open-sourcePrusa Mendel design.
- Commissioned a machine for student and faculty use at Sonoma State University.
- Wrote documentation for machine operation and troubleshooting.
- Achieved tolerances of 0.05mm, with a build area of 170mm x 170mm x 100mm.
- Utilized a renewable plastic feed-stock for printer operation - Polylactic Acid (PLA).

positions.title: Network and Software Applications Engineer
positions.description:
-	Maintained and developed the company’s IT infrastructure.
-	Developed an enterprise-level redundant call center solution.
-	Created software, developed client relations, and wrote system documentation.
-	Demonstrated product for new and prospective clients.

projects.title: SenCell - A Cellular Data Acquisition System
projects.description:
The objective of this project is to design a cellular enabled and modular system that
can monitor conditions of its surrounding environment and relay that data to an
end user. A system such as this is applicable for general purpose telemetry that can
be used for monitoring of microclimates, water quality, tank levels, security, just to
name a few. The applications are endless. This system will consist of two basic nodes:
(1) a sensory node that is placed into the field to gather data and (2) an internet
enabled central server which collects sensor data from the sensory nodes for the user.
The sensory nodes will communicate with the server using the GSM/GPRS cellular
network. Using a PIC32 microcontroller and a GSM/GPRS modem, the sensory node
will have the ability to send collected information to the remote server for analysis
by the end user. Data will be made available to the user in the form of a comma
separated value (CSV) file, containing both time-stamps and data parameters for each
sensory node.
This system is especially interesting for autonomously collecting and aggregating
environmental data for study in the areas of biology, ecology, meteorology, geology,
and environment sciences. Thus, this system allows for scientists to focus on the
research of their interest, rather than data collection.

Keywords: PIC32, I2C, UART, RTC, EEPROM, GSM, GPRS, FTP, M2M, embedded, telemetry
